title: GTA 6 Soundtrack Leak: Album Track List Surfaces Online
description: The GTA 6 soundtrack leak reportedly reveals the full album track list, with Rolling Stone confirming it days before the November 19, 2026 launch.

body.text: The latest GTA 6 soundtrack leak appears to have exposed every song and artist on Grand Theft Auto VI: The Album, just days before the game's launch. According to IGN, the details came from a video apparently shot at a Barnes & Noble-like retailer, and Rolling Stone has confirmed the track list with its own sources. For fans counting down to Vice City, it is another sign that Rockstar is struggling to keep a lid on things.
What the GTA 6 soundtrack leak shows

The clip circulating on social media shows the front, back and spines of the album's double LP vinyl. IGN says the video was still online hours after it spread, and that it gives a full view of the songs and artists on the official album.

One caveat: IGN notes there are likely more tunes inside the game itself, so the album is not necessarily the complete in-game music library. We are not reproducing the list here, since the source text we have does not spell it out in full.
What fans already knew about the music

Rockstar has been teasing its music picks for a while. According to IGN, artists such as Travis Scott, Future and Morgan Wallen hinted at being included as recently as September. Players also heard some of the game's songs when the Extended Look premiered in August.
IGN describes the selection as a mix of genres for cruising through Vice City, which matches what many fans had guessed.
GTA 6 release date and other music releases
GTA 6 is set to launch for PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S on November 19, 2026. The $50 vinyl album is planned for the same date, per IGN.

This album is separate from Grand Theft Auto VI: Original Score by French electronic duo Justice, who are Grammy winners. That score is getting its own physical release for collectors on December 11, 2026.
Other recent news, as listed by IGN:

items: Rockstar has promised the new game will include mechanisms to encourage empathy, a first for the franchise.
Rockstar showed a closer look at Macca & Friends, an animated TV series that can be watched in-game.
Recent gameplay clips are impressing players, according to IGN.

body.text: With launch only days away, expect more leaks and more official reveals to land in quick succession. Keep an eye on whether Rockstar or the artists comment on the album leak, and on how the full track list compares with the music you hear once the game is in your hands on November 19. Until then, treat anything unverified with caution. This one, at least, has been confirmed by Rolling Stone's sources.

faqs.q: Has the GTA 6 album track list leaked?
faqs.a: According to IGN, the full track list for Grand Theft Auto VI: The Album seems to have leaked through a video of the double LP vinyl at a retailer. Rolling Stone has reportedly confirmed the list with its sources.

faqs.q: When does the GTA 6 album come out?
faqs.a: IGN reports the $50 double LP vinyl is planned to reach store shelves on November 19, 2026, the same day GTA 6 launches. The separate Original Score by Justice is set for December 11, 2026.

faqs.q: Which platforms is GTA 6 launching on?
faqs.a: GTA 6 launches for PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S on November 19, 2026, according to IGN.

sources.title: GTA 6 Leak Seemingly Reveals Official Album's Full Track List Days Before Launch
